repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
wait until((#R_Button).button_button != "pushed")
fired = false
}
wait until((#R_Button).button_button == "pushed")
all(#RobotVacuumCleaner).robotVacuumCleaner_setRobotVacuumCleanerCleaningMode("auto")
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate implements a periodic `if` check instead of a blocking rising-edge wait. The IR requires the action to fire exactly when the button transitions to 'pushed' and then wait for the next transition. The candidate only checks the state at the start of every 1-second iteration, missing transitions that occur between checks, and fails to block until the edge occurs.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with the standard rising-edge state machine: persist a `fired` flag, block until the condition is false if previously fired, block until the condition is true, execute the action, and update the flag. This ensures the action fires on the exact rising edge and respects the 1-second cycle period between completions.
